examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.en: to allow, to let happen; to let in

examples.text: Ну, допустим, я жулик. А ты жадина и не помогаешь людям в беде.
examples.trans: All right, let's say I'm a crook. But you're greedy, and you don't help people in trouble.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

examples.text: Шути свои дурацкие шутки на кухне!
examples.trans: Tell your stupid jokes in the kitchen!

examples.text: Эта дурацкая рыба — как плохой знак.
examples.trans: This stupid fish is like a bad omen.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
I forbid you! Where are you going?

examples.text: Нет, это глупо и опасно. Я тебе запрещаю.
examples.trans: No, this is foolish and dangerous. I forbid you.

звонить.gloss: to call, to phone; to ring

examples.trans: Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, excuse me, there's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: В комплекте = included in the set.

examples.trans: We bought a full set of furniture.

examples.text: Но мальчик идёт с ней в комплекте.
examples.trans: But the boy comes with her in the package.
As you can see, a big hall.
He is standing in the corridor.

examples.text: Проходите, пожалуйста! Как видите, большой коридор, а там кухня.
examples.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

examples.text: Кто-то не оценил твой отличный ход?
examples.trans: Did someone not appreciate your great move?
Finally someone is for the people!

examples.text: Слушай, тут пишут: «Гордость России! Наконец-то кто-то за народ!»
examples.trans: Listen, here they write: 'Pride of Russia! Finally someone is for the people!'
Can I go and have a look?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: to put on (an item of clothing)

examples.trans: He put on his best suit.

examples.text: Карамельно-сливочный цвет. Очень тебе к лицу! Надень куртку.
examples.trans: A caramel-cream colour. It really suits you! Put the jacket on.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.text: Неужели так трудно найти хороший сюжет?
examples.trans: Is it really so difficult to find a good story?

examples.text: Неужели президент накажет вас за правду?
examples.trans: Will the president really punish you for the truth?
Do you really not care at all?

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.note: + на: опоздать на работу = be late for work

examples.text: Чем она плоха? Хорошая старая перчатка!
examples.trans: What's wrong with it? A good old glove!

examples.text: Извините, шеф, не могу пожать вам руку.
examples.trans: Sorry, Chef, I can't shake your hand.

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Всё по правилам, как рыцарский турнир.
examples.trans: All by the rules, like a knights' tournament.
Work, work. It's all for us.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.en: to observe, follow rules or regime

examples.trans: It is important to keep quiet.

examples.text: Тогда соблюдайте режим и не нарушайте.
examples.trans: Then observe the regime and do not violate it.
The teacher looked at us sternly.

examples.text: Нет, я нормально его пугал, строго!
examples.trans: No, I scared him properly, sternly!
The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

examples.text: Послушай, мы сегодня увидимся вечером с тобой?
examples.trans: Listen, will we see each other this evening?
All right, see you in the kitchen, administrator!

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that
